info.name: MediMate Step 27 persisted dose actions and reminder consent
info.description: Creates three synthetic A1/B1/A2 events 15 seconds ahead of the API server clock, waits 20 seconds, then verifies real C2 HTTP/database behavior. No bot/account linking or external message. Dose worker is run separately; no delivery is fabricated. Use a disposable local replica-set app; sessions stay runtime-only.

item.name: Plan future A2 start from actual server clock
Wait for the real future events, then read due occurrences
Record taken with stable operation key
Replay taken returns original effective action
History contains one action after replay

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('All four actions retained, current taken',()=>{pm.expect(d.actions).to.have.lengthOf(4);pm.expect(d.dose.state).to.equal('taken');pm.expect(d.dose.stockSyncStatus).to.equal('not_implemented');});
